Common alarm display word; each bit 1 displays its alarm. x0 E-STOP active: reset required; x1 Scrubber high pressure: reset required; x2 Scrubber very high level: reset required; x3 Scrubber waiting for first RESET; x4 Scrubber high level (LSH-102); x5 Setting rejected; x6 Scrubber drain time limit reached; x7 Scrubber level switch disagreement

BR01 alarm display word; each bit 1 displays its alarm. x0 BR01 E-STOP trip saved; x1 BR01 temperature input fault; x2 BR01 burner lockout; x3 BR01 RUN not received in time; x4 BR01 RUN input lost; x5 BR01 RUN without request; x6 TK01 level too low for BR01; x7 BR01 stopped by scrubber trip
